title: Sidecar send-keys push occasionally delivers the [cam] line without submitting (missing Enter)
description:
OBSERVED (operator, recurring across multiple sessions/contexts): sidecar push lines ([cam] ...) sometimes land in the orchestrator pane's input as TEXT but are not submitted -- the message is produced but the terminating Enter is missing, so the line sits in the input awaiting a manual keystroke. Confirmed live this session: the '[cam] merge-watch timeout: PR #293 not yet merged after 240 polls' line was stalled un-submitted in the operator's input.

ROOT-CAUSE CLASS (known): tmux send-keys must deliver text + Enter in a SINGLE call. Two prior failure modes are documented: (a) Enter sent as a SEPARATE send-keys call becomes a newline in this TUI build instead of submitting (see memory tmux-drive-orchestrator-atomic-enter); (b) `-l` (literal) applied over the control token turns the string 'Enter' into literal text rather than a keypress, so nothing submits (CAM-55, sendkeys-literal-enter-gotcha, dispatch.ts:191 regression that broke all thin-proxies). That the symptom reappears across sessions suggests a remaining non-atomic send-keys path in the sidecar's push (likely multi-line message splitting or a retry path).

SCOPE: audit every send-keys call-site in the sidecar's push path (src/supervisor/*, dispatch) and guarantee atomic text+Enter delivery in one call -- never a standalone Enter, never `-l` over the control token. Pay special attention to multi-line [cam] messages and any retry/re-send path.

VERIFICATION: add an integration guard in the style of test/integration/tmux-introspect.test.ts that asserts REAL submission against a live tmux pane (the message actually reaches the shell/agent), not merely the argv shape -- argv-shape tests lie about tmux semantics (proven CAM-55).

Source: operator report 2026-07-19 during the CAM-357 ship (PR #293) recovery.

spec.scope: Fix the sidecar's orchestrator-pane push so a [cam] line is never silently lost. Grounding overturned the filed hypothesis: all send-keys call sites in src/ are already atomic (text+Enter in one call, no -l), and the IDLE_PROMPT predicate matches the real orchestrator pane. The actual defect is that the post-send verification in sendKeysVerified (src/tmux/dispatch.ts:289-316) is inert, so blind sends into a busy composer are never retried and never reported: (1) capture(paneId) is called immediately after send-keys with zero settle, while capture-pane lags one tmux refresh cycle, so isComposerEmptied sees the not-yet-rendered text and falsely reports delivered on attempt 1; (2) isComposerEmptied (dispatch.ts:181-185) matches line.includes(text) per-line, so any payload that soft-wraps in the composer can never match and is falsely reported delivered. Evidence: the supervisor log holds 5 'did not go idle within 5000 ms; sending anyway' warnings and cam-worker-events.jsonl holds 0 push-undelivered events. Additionally the 5000 ms idle deadline is far too short for an orchestrator legitimately busy running tools, making the blind send-anyway path the common case rather than the exception. Fix scope: add a settle delay before the verification capture, make the composer match wrap-tolerant, raise the idle deadline substantially while keeping send-anyway as a last resort, and cover the path with a real-tmux integration test rather than another argv-shape fake. Out of scope: switching to a transcript/echo-based oracle (couples the sidecar to unversioned TUI transcript rendering), and the send-keys sites outside the shared helper (Dashboard.tsx, retry/tmux.ts, behavioral-gate.ts, setup.ts).
acceptanceCriteria: sendKeysVerified waits at least one tmux refresh cycle between the send-keys spawn and the verification capture, so a not-yet-rendered payload is never read as delivered.
isComposerEmptied tolerates soft-wrapped payloads: a payload longer than the pane width that is still sitting un-submitted in the composer is reported as NOT delivered.
A payload that was genuinely submitted is still reported as delivered, so the retry loop does not resend and trip the back-to-back send-keys race documented at patterns.md:330.
The idle-wait deadline is raised well above 5000 ms and the value is a named constant, not an inline literal.
When retries are exhausted, the push-undelivered event still fires with paneId and retriesExhausted.

A new integration test under test/integration/ boots a real tmux pane on a private socket (reusing the swapSocketSpawn helper pattern) and drives production makeNotifyOrchestrator with a payload wider than the pane, asserting submission via the >=2-occurrence echo oracle used by test/integration/sendkeys-submit.test.ts.
That new integration test fails against the pre-fix verification logic and passes after the fix.
bun test is fully green with no skipped or weakened existing assertions in test/dispatch.test.ts or test/supervisor/notify-orchestrator.test.ts.
gotchas: Do NOT change the argv shape: text and Enter must stay in ONE send-keys call and -l must never be used (CAM-55 sendkeys-literal-enter-gotcha).
capture-pane lags by one tmux refresh cycle; this lag is the root cause and any verification that reads immediately after the send is unsound.

The sidecar wires a DIFFERENT capture reader than the unit tests: host.ts:579-586 passes capture-pane -p -S - (full scrollback) while dispatch.ts:191-198 and host.ts:270-275 use the visible-screen read. The last-5-lines window therefore means something different in production than in every fake-backed test; reconcile this or the fix will pass tests and still fail live.

A submitted line is echoed into the transcript and stays visible in the tail, so a naive not-delivered check produces false negatives and duplicate sends; back-to-back send-keys into the Ink prompt race and the second line is swallowed (patterns.md:330, merge-watch.ts:658-662).
Bare sleeps are banned under test/integration/; use test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts.
Integration tests must run on a private tmux socket and kill-server around themselves; never touch the live -L cam socket, which is running the operator's real session.
Argv-shape tests with scripted capturePaneFn stubs cannot catch this class of bug: the fakes return exactly what the code expects. A real-tmux test is required.
domainTerms: sendKeysVerified: the shared send+verify+retry helper in src/tmux/dispatch.ts, sole production emitter of [cam] lines.
isComposerEmptied: the submission oracle that decides whether the payload left the composer.
IDLE_PROMPT / BUSY_GLYPHS: the regexes behind isOrchPaneIdle.
send-anyway path: the branch taken when waitForIdlePane times out; it sends into a possibly-busy composer.
push-undelivered: the structured event logged when the retry loop exhausts.
swapSocketSpawn: the test helper that rewrites -L cam to a private socket so production code runs against an isolated tmux server.
